Name: FastPetting
Author: DerTod2
Description:
This mod allows to pet all animals on your farm by simply pressing a configurable button (default "P").
You can also set an option to pet all animals each day automatically.
When pressed a message with the info which player and how many animals where petted will be shown to all connected players.
When no "un-petted" animals are on the farm a info is displayed.

[list]
[*]This mod ignores your dog or cat!
[*]This mod should be compatible with all other mods.
[*]This mod is my first mod to test the possibilities of SMAPI.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Added new config "AutoPetting" so the game pets all animals automatically each day.
Added locales for French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Turkish.
